answer.evidence: The silhouette is a plain 32px-wide rectangle from rows 13 to 63. Inside it, a 5-row cycle repeats ten times: a 1-row highlight (L=223), a 2-row light tread (L=197), then a 2-row dark band (L=63). Each light band is a tread ending in a dark riser, but the risers are only 2 rows and there is no tall front face. The whole object reads as a flat top-down staircase pattern or striped slab, with narrow darker strips down both edges. It has no rock volume, no organic outline and no single top-plus-front block, so the stated kind (organic rock) does not match.

It has the sticker look, with no dark-material-tone outline and no organic texture, so it is below the Beodeul bar.
